title: TierProfile
description: The dials that make one node (orrethd) a Universe, Ecosystem, or Field (0000 §1). This v0 carries every dial already locked by decisions (retention 0003, TTLs 0006, QA sample, judge sampling 0001, cadence); the 0004 narrative spec will refine, not redefine. tier_label is FRIENDLY DISPLAY ONLY — wire contracts never branch on it.

tier_label.description: Display name (e.g. 'universe', 'ecosystem', 'field', or anything a customer likes). Never used for logic.

parent_endpoint.description: Absent ⇒ apex. PUSH up / PULL down; a parent never reaches in.

is_leaf.description: true ⇒ children are Agents (a Field); false ⇒ children are Harnesses.

clock.description: The two-clock model (0004 §1, locked 2026-07-02): meaning runs on universe-time; security and money run on wall-clock. Memory dials below are universe-time; token TTLs, heartbeats, co-signs are wall-clock.

mode.description: 'declared' ⇒ the universe asserts its own now (bursty sims welcome); 'wall' ⇒ universe-time tracks physical time 1:1.

high_water_scope.description: Monotonicity enforced per this scope (default: this profile's own scope). Lived records below the high-water mark are rejected — backdating is structurally detectable.

dilation_hint.description: Display/ops only (pane scrubber, cost projection) — never logic.

objective.description: The objective vector (0004 §3, locked 2026-07-02) — what 'good' means at this tier; the dial the governance loop steers by. Shape locked here; scoring semantics land in 0005. A 'floor: true' objective never trades off.

retention_classes.description: Compliance retention per record class (0004 §4, locked 2026-07-02): min = keep-at-least (SOX/books-and-records), max = keep-at-most (GDPR/consent). Cascade enforces each direction independently, tighten-only (min may rise, max may fall). Legal hold = a governed, temporary min of 'forever' on a scope. Bounds the metabolism dials in 'memory'.

min.description: Deleting earlier than this is the violation. 'forever' = legal hold.

max.description: Keeping longer than this is the violation.

raw_retention.description: UNIVERSE-TIME (0004 §1). Starting leans: P90D field · per-floors eco.

distilled_retention.description: Starting leans: P13M eco · forever at apex.

qa_sample_rate.description: Sealed 1-in-N raw kept past horizon to measure distillation loss (locked 2026-07-01). Leans: 0.01 field · 0.001 eco.

horizon.description: How far back this tier serves before delegating up. 'forever' = the apex: no time restriction — all of spacetime.

on_budget_exhaustion.description: Locked 2026-07-01: floors never stop; surge distills coarsely; quality-drift signal raised; never backpressure ingestion.

judge_sample_rate.description: model_judge steady-state sampling (locked: 1-in-N steady, 1.0 forced during canary).

routing.description: How this layer reaches models. No agent calls a model ungoverned.

join_default.description: The join spectrum default for children (floors compelled for the joined).

mode.description: did-web = resolvable under orreth.ai; pinned = out-of-band root for self-hosted/air-gapped (locked 2026-07-01).

root.description: did:web DID or pinned root key, per mode.
